subject: Disconnected deployment: artifact handoff & operator rollback plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Acme Ops <ops@acmehealth.example>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Disconnected deployment: artifact handoff & operator rollback plan

Team — initiating the handoff for Acme Health's disconnected appliance update (release tag: r2027.05.29-sterile). Please review the proposed operator handshake and rollback sequence below; Acme requires explicit chain-of-custody and an operator rollback runbook for their audit.

High-level ask:
- Confirm signing artifact and manifest format (we plan HSM-signed JSON manifest + per-operator short-lived certs).
- Approve scheduled handoff window: Thu 2027-06-03 02:00–06:00 PDT (overnight maintenance).
- Confirm on-site courier protocol (Acme expects tamper-evident seals + 2-person verification).

Proposed steps (draft):
1) Build immutable image and generate manifest (checksums + provenance).
2) HSM sign manifest; upload signature to DocuSign envelope for customer acknowledgement.
3) Create operator bundle with one-time operator certs, printed QR for offline bootstrap.
4) Courier delivers sealed media to Acme airlock; on-site ops verify seal and scan QR to authenticate bundle.
5) Operator applies update; KV-cache migration performed offline via staged script; island-test validation run.
6) If validation fails, operator runs local rollback script which reverts to previous image and writes rollback report to tamper-evident journal.

Attachments: 20270530-sterile-manifest-signed.json (draft), operator-handshake-checklist.pdf

Please reply with redlines. Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Acme Ops <ops@acmehealth.example>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Disconnected deployment: artifact handoff & operator rollback plan

Mina — thanks for the clear plan. A few practical notes from runtime/ops side:

- Image / manifest: include per-layer SHA256 and a manifest version field (we should use v2 so customer parsing is straightforward).
- Operator certs: make them time-limited to the maintenance window + 1 hour. Don't rely on online OCSP checks (customer is air-gapped). Embed CRLs in the bundle.
- Island-test harness: add a smoke-test that verifies model load + KV cache restore, not just process up. We saw cases where process was up but tokenization failed.

Rollbacks: outline an automated safe-fail path in the first 30 minutes post-apply. If telemetry is unavailable (likely), fallback to explicit operator-initiated rollback with checksum verification. Log format should be JSONL so it can be ingested later.

I'll update operator-handshake-checklist.pdf with these items and attach a sample CRL blob. Will also add a short CLI sequence for the operator.

—Jonas

- Courier needs manifest signature copy and a printed SHA summary for the transport manifest.
- On-site verification: Acme wants two Acme sign-offs + our remote witness (phone). We'll include a tamper-evident label with serial.
- Emergency rollback kit: courier will carry a sealed USB with prior image and the rollback script (encrypted, passphrase handed to Acme ops during handoff).

Courier (securelogistics) — can you confirm you can deliver during our requested window and support the tamper-evident labeling? Also confirm whether the driver can be on a 2-person chain (driver + supervisor).

- We require the signed manifest in DocuSign (so we have a time-stamped acknowledgement) and a printed manifest placed inside the sealed media.
- Operator training: please include a 30-minute on-site walkthrough video and a 1-page rollback cheat sheet.
- Compliance note: rollback reports must include operator badge IDs and verifying witness.

Mina — can you finalize the DocuSign envelope and the printed manifest text (we will notarize the acceptance on-site). We'll sign as soon as DocuSign is available.

Lena Ortiz
